title: Kagamine Rin — Original Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come on everybody, let's raise the roof♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you three later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey guys!
Is everybody enjoying the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone here at the venue is having fun! How about all of you at the remote screenings and everybody watching the stream?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Having a great time!>
<So fun!>
<I'm watching it stood up in front of my monitor!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, seems everyone's enjoying it to the fullest.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We've gotta keep this energy coming!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why you came up with a really interesting discussion topic for today, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
H-Hey now!
Don't set the bar so high.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I did think of something, but like, whether it's interesting or not is a different question...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You thought your hardest to come up with it, so I'm sure it'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! C'mon, be confident!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sheesh, you're the one who set the bar that high, and now you're just saying whatever you want.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
My bad, sorry!
So, what are we gonna talk about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go ahead and announce the topic.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The topic I've prepared for us to discuss today is...gaps!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So after this, the three of us are going to sing songs that'll really make you feel a gap in expectations!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: To go along with that, I thought it'd be cool if we could talk about the songs we all sing that make us feel some sort of gap in expectations!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds interesting!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right? First, about KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, when do you feel a gap watching KAITO sing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, I guess songs where he looks mean or scary while he sings? I mean, you never see KAITO actually make that sort of face.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know what you mean! Also, the same goes for songs with screaming, right?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you're always super cool when you sing those kinds of songs, so I wanna see you sing more of them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You do? Then, I guess I'll take that into consideration when thinking up set lists from now on.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, next is about us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, when do you feel a gap watching us sing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Let's see...
My impression of you two is that you're always smiling and full of energy, so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I really feel a gap whenever you do darker songs or when you're softly singing a ballad.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?
Are we cool when we sing those sorts of songs?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You heard him, Rin!
Should we sing a whole lot of those in our future shows?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That could be good!
But not if it doesn't fit with the type of show we're trying to put on, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
C'mon, I know that!
I mean, what was the saying about time?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... A stitch in time saves nine?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not quite! That's about fixing a problem before it gets worse.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's about herbs!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I think you mean, “There's a time and a place for everything.”

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Ooh! That's the one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How was the discussion topic I came up with, everyone? Was it fun enough?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, I guess you all enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everybody watching the stream is saying it was interesting too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We also got comments saying, “That topic was the best!” and “I wanna hear more!”.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?! I'm so glad!
Now I can fully focus on singing our next song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, now it's time to let the cat out of the bag!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mentioned how we're going to sing songs that'll make you feel a gap, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actuallyyy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna be singing two songs back to back that are sooooo different from each other, you'll feel the temperature in here change like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, hold up!>
<That's what you meant with the gap thing?!>
<No no no. I'm not ready!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Since the temperature's about to go all over the place, did you all bring cold medicine today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha... There's no way they did.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But we just warned them, so we'll call it good♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay everyone, ready to catch a cold?

rows.Speaker: KAITO, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Start the music!
